speakers.name: You don't need Fable for that: comparing Jev, open models, and classical ML approach to text classification
speakers.info: When you have a powerful hammer, everything looks like a nail. But many tasks can be done faster and cheaper using smaller, local, or specialized models. We'll compare how several different approaches fare on a typical AI task: text classification.
speakers.bio: Senko Rašić has been a software engineer and an active member of the Croatian developer community for several decades, creating a Linux distribution, cofounding the local Ubuntu user group and the WebCamp Zagreb conference. He maintains Cijene API, an open-source project that collects 10 million retail prices a day. Today at VibeScale he helps companies adopt AI in their software development practices and integrate AI into their products.
